text: Ko Menen woni wuurnitooɓe maayɓe ɓen, fii hasbugol Ñalnde Darngal, Men winnda ko ɓe ardini kon aduna e golle bonɗe maa moƴƴe, e batteeji maɓɓe heddinooɗi ɓaawo maayde maɓɓe, wano sadaaki ilooji, maa bonɗi maɓɓe heddinooɗi, wano keeferaaku. Gomɗi Men moftii kala huunde, e deftere ɓanngunde, nden woni alluwal reenaangal ngal.
